document.abstract: A representative selection of television film commercials was evaluated for picture quality (not content) in a film preview room conforming to a proposed recommended practice. The same observers evaluated these films subsequently when they were displayed on television picture monitors using GE PE240 and RCA TK-27 4-vidicon telecines as the transducers. The correlation of the scores given each picture for the optical and the television presentation is given. This correlation should give confidence to users of the film preview room that their judgment will apply to television display.
